description: Cases for the search that the `forbidden` patterns of a configuration use, in the shape of the cases of patterns.json. `finds` and `findsNot`: a part of each string in `finds` must match, and no part of a string in `findsNot` may; `matches` and `rejects` are for the whole string. On every string of a case, the search with its shortcut and the search that tries every position must agree, and so must the engine of the language, given the pattern as it is. `required` is the text every match contains, as the packages derive it (the empty string when they derive none): a value without that text is not tried, and every string in which a match is found must contain it. The file is written by spec/generate-search.mjs from a fixed seed; the expectations of what matches are those of an ECMAScript engine.
